notes: Allowlisted tutorial title/body overlays only. Unknown tours/keys are ignored. No scripts, no remote code. Bundled links/actions/selectors stay local.

main.title: Welcome to MSBT
main.body:
You need Borderlands 4 + the MSBT SDK mod (.sdkmod in the game’s sdk_mods folder) + this Electron app. Live actions also need a connected bridge — use Status in the header or Refresh Status in Boosting → Target Player.

Offline: serial convert/validate. Live (game + mod + bridge): boosting, spawns, travel, delivery.

Put MattsSDKBoostingTools.sdkmod next to ActorScriptDeployer under Borderlands 4/sdk_mods/. Or use Updates → Install / Update SDK Mod.

Tip: Updates → Refresh Catalogs pulls the latest serial/travel/pool JSON without a full app reinstall. Use the release download button below for the app + .sdkmod package.

main.title: Boosting
main.body:
This is the main live lobby tab. Pick a target player, All Players, or Other Players, then use Essentials, Combat & Cheats, rarity weights, backpack/bank size, and serial rewards.

Shinies Deliver follows the Boost target scope. Shinies Drop remains a ground drop. Drop All Backpack is always host-only. Most buttons need the bridge — use Status in the header or Refresh Status in Target Player first. Serial Rewards use their own Selected / All Players / Other Players delivery buttons.

Tip: after a catalog refresh, BL4 Codes / travel / pools stay current without reinstalling the Electron app.

main.title: Serial Tools
main.body:
Paste a @U or decoded serial → Convert to decode parts and rebuild @U (works offline). Validate serials, save keepers as Bookmarks (named groups), then Deliver Selected / All / Non-Host when the bridge is connected.

Tip: BL4 Codes → Load Catalog / Refresh Catalogs pulls the same remote serial seeds used by desktop cache — handy when a code was truncated or newly published.

main.title: Updates
main.body:
Check Desktop App, Game SDK Stack, and Catalog Data here. Download desktop updates, or Install / Update SDK Mod into your Borderlands 4 sdk_mods folder. Fully restart the game after any SDK change.

Refresh Catalogs updates high-churn JSON (codes, travel, pools, Dev Spawner, tutorial tips) from the MSBT data channel — separate from app SemVer. It soft-fails offline and keeps your last-good cache.

main.title: Arrange your layout
main.body:
Every dockable tab has a layout toolbar: switch between Fixed and Panels where offered, drag panels by the title bar, stack by dropping center-on-center, use Compact to tidy, and Reset for defaults.

Tips: stack Target with Essentials on Boosting; use Compact when panels overlap; Reset if a tab feels lost. Full editor tour is on the next screen — or View → Layout walkthrough anytime.
